violations.description: Unsafe pull_request_target workflow executing untrusted PR code with write permissions
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml triggers on pull_request_target, checks out github.event.pull_request.head.sha, and grants contents: write permissions.
violations.recommendation: Use the standard pull_request trigger instead of pull_request_target when checking out untrusted PR head code.

violations.description: CI workflow omits tests and linters and does not trigger on pushes
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml only triggers on pull_request_target and runs python scripts/build.py, omitting pytest and ruff check as described in README.md.
violations.recommendation: Update CI workflow to trigger on push and pull_request, and add steps to run pytest and ruff check.
